title: Differentiation of induced pluripotent stem cells into retinal pigment epithelial cells
author: Zorin, Ewerling-Hähnel, et al.

steps.title: Freeze immature RPE cells (Day 42)
steps.instruction: Warm RPE medium, DPBS, Gentle Dissociation Buffer, Accutase, KO serum replacement and DMSO to room temperature. Prepare cryovials (≈2 per well of a 6‑well plate) and a freezing box with 2‑propanol. Make freezing medium (90 % KO serum replacement, 10 % DMSO).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate RPE medium and wash each well with 2 mL sterile DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS and add 1 mL Gentle Dissociation Buffer per well; incubate 5 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Tap plate gently to release non‑RPE cell spheres; aspirate the buffer containing the spheres.
Add 1 mL Accutase A per well; incubate 10–15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Detach cells with a cell scraper or by pipetting; repeatedly resuspend to obtain a uniform single‑cell suspension.
Wet a cell strainer with DPBS, filter the suspension into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 2 mL RPE medium to the original well, resuspend remaining cells, and filter through the same strainer into the tube.
Centrifuge at 0.4 RCF for 5 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in fresh RPE medium, count cells, then centrifuge again at 0.4 RCF for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in freezing medium to a final concentration of 2 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Aliquot 1 mL of the suspension into each pre‑labeled cryovial.
Place cryovials in the freezing container and store overnight at –80 °C; transfer to liquid nitrogen the next day for long‑term storage.
CRITICAL: If cells detach as a sheet or large clump at step A, skip to the Accutase step.

steps.title: Thaw frozen immature RPE cells (Day 42)
steps.instruction: Warm RPE medium and DPBS to room temperature; pre‑heat a water bath to 37 °C. Coat a 6‑well plate with 1 mL Geltrex per well for 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then aspirate Geltrex and add 1 mL DPBS per well (plate can be kept in the incubator until needed).

substeps.instruction: Place a cryovial in the 37 °C water bath for 2–3 min until fully thawed.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube; wash the vial with 1 mL RPE medium and add to the tube.
Centrifuge at 0.4 RCF for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in RPE medium.
Seed 2 × 10⁶ cells per well (4 mL RPE medium per well) of the 6‑well plate.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Cultivate immature RPE cells (Days 43‑48)
steps.instruction: Maintain the cultures in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and change RPE medium three times per week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) using 4 mL per well. Monitor morphology: fibroblast‑like cells on Day 43, decreasing size and emergence of hexagonal clusters by Day 48. Non‑RPE cells form small 3D spheres on top of the monolayer until Day 48; these can be removed on Day 49.

steps.title: Seed RPE cells onto transwells (Day 49)
steps.instruction: Warm RPE medium, DPBS, Gentle Dissociation Buffer and Accutase to room temperature. Prepare P‑12 transwells by coating each insert with 200 µL Geltrex for 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then aspirate Geltrex and add 500 µL DPBS per insert (keep in incubator until use).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate RPE medium from the culture and wash each well with 2 mL sterile DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS and add 1 mL Gentle Dissociation Buffer per well; incubate 5 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Tap plate gently to release non‑RPE spheres; aspirate the buffer containing the spheres.
Add 1 mL Accutase per well; incubate 10–15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Detach cells with a scraper or pipetting; repeatedly resuspend to obtain a single‑cell suspension.
Wet a cell strainer with DPBS, filter the suspension into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 2 mL RPE medium to the original well, resuspend remaining cells, and filter through the same strainer into the tube.
Centrifuge at 0.4 RCF for 5 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in fresh RPE medium and count cells.
Aspirate DPBS from the transwell inserts.
Seed 5.5 × 10⁵ cells per transwell; add 300 µL RPE medium to the upper chamber and 900 µL to the lower chamber.
Place the plate in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.
CRITICAL: If cells detach as a sheet at the tapping step, skip directly to the Accutase incubation.

steps.title: Mature RPE cells on transwells (Days 50‑77)
steps.instruction: Continue culture in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator, changing RPE medium three times per week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) with the same volumes as before. Record transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER) at the end of each week. Handle the monolayer gently during medium changes to avoid scratching; TEER cannot be measured after the sheet is damaged. After four weeks on transwells, cells should display mature RPE morphology: small size, hexagonal shape, and high pigmentation.

steps.title: Perform qPCR on RPE markers
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from RPE cells at three key time points: (1) before seeding onto transwells (progenitor stage), (2) after 2 weeks of transwell culture, and (3) after 4 weeks of transwell culture. Conduct quantitative RT‑PCR for canonical RPE markers RPE65, RLBP1 and BEST1. Expect a significant increase in expression levels compared with the progenitor stage, indicating progressive maturation.

description: Before you start, you should obtain an iPSC culture by purchasing an established cell line from a cell bank or by reprogramming cells, such as human dermal skin fibroblasts or lymphoblasts by yourself. We perform episomal reprogramming of fibroblasts into human iPSCs by transfecting the cell using the Yamanaka factors OCT3/4, SOX2, KLF4, L-MYC and the embryonic stem cell specific microRNA miR302/367.1 iPSCs should be carefully characterized, including testing for the most common copy number variations, performing embryoid body assay formation followed by immunocytochemistry and in case of patient-derived cells, Sanger sequencing to determine the type of disease-causing mutations.
